# appdynamics Provider

Manages Splunk AppDynamics alerting configuration (health rules, policies, actions, schedules) via the Controller Platform APIs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    appdynamics = {
      source = "pmateos-cisco/appdynamics"
    }
  }
}

provider "appdynamics" {
  controller_url = "https://se-lab.saas.appdynamics.com"
  client_id      = "terraform-pmateos@se-lab" # <api_client_name>@<account_name>
  client_secret  = var.appdynamics_client_secret
}

variable "appdynamics_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) OAuth API client ID, in the form <api_client_name>@<account_name>. May also be set via the APPD_CLIENT_ID environment variable.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth API client secret. May also be set via the APPD_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable.
- `controller_url` (String) AppDynamics Controller base URL, e.g. https://mycompany.saas.appdynamics.com. May also be set via the APPD_CONTROLLER_URL environment variable.
